cases.prompt: Add a statistic for reagent returns across craft history.
cases.expected: Calculate only from supported observations while preserving coverage and unknowns.
assertions: Do not convert unknown returned quantities or incomplete sets to zero.
Use the canonical craft-by-item grain and bounded queries.
Preserve decimal precision and test mixed known/unknown observations.

cases.prompt: Import a later snapshot with extra historical schematic evidence and a changed known output.
cases.expected: Distinguish compatible evidence enrichment from a contradictory canonical fact.
assertions: Reject the changed known canonical output rather than choosing a winner.
Do not commit a partial conflicting batch.

cases.prompt: Implement a bounded history query with child rows and cancellation.
cases.expected: Use the existing HistoryStore read ownership and batching model.
assertions: Use parameterized SQL and an explicit read transaction.
Batch child materialization in the same read snapshot.
Propagate cancellation and do not close a connection under active work.
